lines.text: I've learned to love myself more,
manage loss and harvest a wizardry more brilliant
than the scarlet poppies and purple blossoms
Yet from a distant window, beautiful and calm,
And if you notice me and capture my eyes
stepping back and letting them say hello,
in windless seasons and scarlet poppies
won't prevent me from sharing a smile
worth the promise of my heart.
Don't make me leave and go where promises, hearts,
spectrums of light-filled constellations are broken.
The way you see things felt safe and timeless.
Whatever has terminated this moment, damn you,
but let it feel love and lost as we must endure,
absent artificial escapes and machine learning strengths
for my highs and lows as resource materials.
